observations.finding: 20/50 pathways significant at q<0.05; top effects include HALLMARK_PANCREAS_BETA_CELLS down (SMD -0.977, q=0.00025), HALLMARK_HEME_METABOLISM down (SMD -0.864, q=0.00105), HALLMARK_IL6_JAK_STAT3_SIGNALING up (SMD 0.684, q=0.00105), HALLMARK_ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION up (SMD 0.686, q=0.00129), HALLMARK_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE up (SMD 0.572, q=0.00343).

2/22 genes significant at q<0.05; PBRM1 depleted (freq 0.246 vs 0.571, OR 0.245, 95% CI 0.105-0.569, q=0.0224) and ATM absent in set (0.0 vs 0.143, OR 0.046, q=0.0404). BAP1 enriched but not significant (0.180 vs 0.048, OR 4.4, q=0.377).

20/49 continuous features significant; VHL, SETD2, PBRM1, BAP1 loci higher in set (Cliff's delta ~0.52-0.55, q<0.001). Gain/loss: chr14q loss enriched (0.541 vs 0.214, OR 4.32, q=0.0105), chr6p loss (0.180 vs 0.0, OR 19.4, q=0.020), CDKN2A loss (0.344 vs 0.095, OR 4.99, q=0.033).

evidence_reports.statistical_interpretation: Coherent multi-modality signal: RNA shows inflammatory/IL6-JAK-STAT3 up-regulation with beta-cell and heme metabolism down; WXS shows PBRM1 depletion and ATM absence; CNV shows enrichment of VHL/SETD2/PBRM1/BAP1 locus alterations and chr14q/chr6p/CDKN2A losses. Effects are moderate-to-large with adjusted significance.
evidence_reports.medical_interpretation: C0001 exhibits a biologically coherent profile with inflammatory pathway activation and a distinctive genomic alteration pattern (PBRM1-low, ATM-absent, chr14q/CDKN2A loss). This is consistent with a meaningful molecular subtype identity, though clinical implications are not established.
limitations: Pathway and mutation analyses are relative to the rest of the partition, not an external reference.
BAP1 enrichment is not statistically significant.

limitations: Pathway and mutation analyses are relative to the rest of the partition, not an external reference.

actions.reason: C0001 has coherent multi-modality identity evidence (inflammatory/IL6-JAK-STAT3 activation, PBRM1 depletion, ATM absence, chr14q/CDKN2A loss) with confounder testing showing no set-level technical association. Cross-modal membership support is directionally consistent but silhouettes are near zero and resampling ARI is moderate, so structure remains uncertain; no available request could resolve this within the round budget, and no positive evidence supports split or merge. Retain for downstream validation.

C0002 shows a coherent reciprocal identity profile (beta-cell/heme metabolism up, inflammatory pathways down, PBRM1/ATM enrichment, absence of chr14q/CDKN2A loss) with no set-level technical confounding. Cross-modal support is positive but weak, with low resampling ARI, so structure is uncertain; no available request could resolve this and no positive evidence supports split or merge. Retain for downstream validation.
